description:
KILLEEN, Texas (KWTX) - 7th Heaven Smoke Shop in Killeen said it is tightening up security measures after the store was robbed at gun point.

Owner Natasha Mayhorn told KWTX that a man entered the store wanting to buy a pipe at about 6 p.m. on Sept. 3.

He followed the store’s employee behind the counter, pulled out a gun and demanded money from the cash register.

“Horrible. I’m very insecure. I’ve been having mixed feelings. Do I even want to keep the store or do I want to let it go” They just took the money for our bills,” said Mayhorn.
